LanguageData.MST.equippableBaseBodySizeComment: Minimum body size required to use the gear (BodySize ≥ this value). A negative value means "mounted only": body size is not compared at all and only the whitelists below apply. Takes effect on the next equip check; already-equipped weapons are not re-validated.
LanguageData.MST.equippableByRaceComment: These races can always use it. OR-ed with the apparel / hediff / gene whitelists; any single match passes, before the body-size check.
LanguageData.MST.equippableWithApparelComment: Wearing any one of these apparel items is enough to use the tier (power armor, mech suits…).
LanguageData.MST.equippableWithHediffComment: Having any one of these hediffs is enough (vanilla bionic / archotech arms work this way).
LanguageData.MST.equippableWithGeneComment: Having any one of these genes is enough (requires Biotech).
LanguageData.MST.isMountedWeaponComment: Read-only: true when the minimum body size is negative, i.e. the tier is only usable on vehicles / turret mounts.
LanguageData.MST.usedByWeaponsComment: Click to list every weapon / gear item using this heavy tier; click an entry to jump. Read-only, computed by a reverse lookup.
LanguageData.MST.heavyTierComment: The heavy tier this weapon requires. Empty = no heavy requirement. Mech weapons are additionally limited by the race's weapon filter (tags / tech / class); when that filter is enabled it bypasses the body-size gate.
LanguageData.MST.mechWeaponFilterComment: Click to open the mech weapon filter window: tags / tech levels / weapon classes / bypass weapons in one place. Only affects mechs implementing Fortified IWeaponUsable.
LanguageData.MST.mechWeaponFilterIntro: These settings only affect mechs implementing Fortified IWeaponUsable (DMS automatroid). Every change is written back to the DefModExtension and recorded immediately.
LanguageData.MST.enableWeaponFilterOnComment: On: only the tag / tech / class filters below apply; the heavy tier's body-size gate no longer applies to this mech (heavy-tier whitelists can still let it through).
LanguageData.MST.enableWeaponFilterOffComment: Off: the heavy tier's body-size gate applies; weapons without a heavy extension are allowed outright.
LanguageData.MST.usableTechLevelsComment: Only the checked tech levels are accepted. Takes effect when the tech-level filter is enabled.
LanguageData.MST.usableWeaponClassesComment: A weapon must have at least one of these weaponClasses. Takes effect when the class filter is enabled.
LanguageData.MST.bypassUsableWeaponsComment: Matched by weapon defName; overrides every filter rule. Add them with the weapon picker.
LanguageData.MST.mechWeaponFilterStatusOn: Current: tag / tech / class filter only; the body-size gate is bypassed.
LanguageData.MST.mechWeaponFilterStatusOff: Current: heavy-tier body-size gate (weapons without a heavy extension are allowed outright).
LanguageData.MST.mechWeaponFilterWarningEmptyTags: Warning: the filter is on but no usable tags are set — every weapon with weaponTags will be rejected (Fortified also logs a warning).
LanguageData.MST.mechWeaponFilterBodySize: Current body size: {0} (heavy tiers compare BodySize ≥ threshold).
